verses.text: I dey talk di truth for Christ. I no dey lie, as my conscience dey testify with me for Holy Spirit,
say I get great sorrow and pain wey no dey stop for my heart.
Because I fit wish say make dem curse me myself from Christ for my brothers sake, my relatives according to di flesh,
wey be Israelites; wey di adoption, di glory, di covenants, di giving of di law, di service, and di promises belong to;
wey di papa dem belong to, and from whom Christ come as concerning di flesh, wey dey over all, God wey dem bless forever. Amen.
But e no be like say God word don come to nothing. Because no be all wey come from Israel be Israel.
No, because dem be Abraham seed, no mean say dem all be pikin dem. But, “Through Isaac dem go call your seed.”
Wey mean say, no be di pikin dem of di flesh be God pikin dem, but dem count di pikin dem of di promise as heirs.
Because this na word of promise, “For this time I go come, and Sarah go get son.”
No only so, but Rebekah get belle too by one, by our papa Isaac.
Because as dem never born, and dem never do anything good or bad, so that God purpose according to election go stand, no be by works, but by di one wey dey call,
dem talk to am say, “Di older go serve di younger.”
Even as e dey write, “Jacob I love, but Esau I hate.”
Wetin den we go talk? Unrighteousness dey with God? E no go ever happen!
Because e talk to Moses, “I go show mercy to whom I show mercy, and I go get compassion for whom I get compassion.”
So e no dey of di one wey want, or di one wey run, but of God wey dey show mercy.
Because di Scripture talk to Pharaoh, “Na for this very purpose I raise you up, so that I go show my power inside you, and so that dem go proclaim my name for all di earth.”
So e dey show mercy to whom e want, and e dey harden whom e want.
You go talk to me den, “Why e still dey find fault? Because who fit stand against im will?”
But truly, O man, who you be to reply against God? Di thing wey dem form go ask di one wey form am, “Why you make me like this?”
Or di potter no get right over di clay, from di same lump to make one part vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
Wetin if God, as e want show im wrath, and make im power known, bear with much patience vessels of wrath wey dem prepare for destruction,
and so that e go make known di riches of im glory on vessels of mercy, wey e prepare before for glory,
us, wey e call too, no be from di Jews only, but from di Gentiles too?
As e talk for Hosea too, “I go call di people wey no be my people ‘my people,’ and di one wey no beloved, ‘beloved.’”
“E go happen say for di place wia dem talk to dem, ‘Una no be my people,’ na there dem go call dem ‘pikin dem of di living God.’”
Isaiah cry about Israel, “If di number of Israel pikin dem be like sand of di sea, na only di remnant go dey saved;
because e go finish di work and cut am short for righteousness, because di Lord go do short work for di earth.”
As Isaiah don talk before, “Unless di Lord of Armies leave us seed, we go don become like Sodom, and we go don be like Gomorrah.”
Wetin den we go talk? Say di Gentiles, wey no follow after righteousness, reach righteousness, even di righteousness wey dey of faith;
but Israel, as dem dey follow after law of righteousness, no reach di law of righteousness.
Why? Because dem no seek am by faith, but like say na by works of di law. Dem stumble over di stumbling stone;
even as e dey write, “Look, I dey lay for Zion stumbling stone and rock of offense; and nobody wey believe am go dey disappointed.”
Brothers, my heart desire and my prayer to God na for Israel, so that dem go dey saved.
Because I testify about dem say dem get zeal for God, but no according to knowledge.
Because as dem no know God righteousness, and dey try establish dem own righteousness, dem no subject demself to di righteousness of God.
Because Christ na di fulfillment of di law for righteousness to everybody wey believe.
Because Moses write about di righteousness wey dey of di law, “Di one wey do dem go live by dem.”
But di righteousness wey dey of faith talk say, “No talk for your heart, ‘Who go go up enter heaven?’—wey mean, to bring Christ down—
or ‘Who go go down enter di abyss?’—wey mean, to bring Christ up from di dead.”
But wetin e talk? “Di word near you, for your mouth, and for your heart;” wey mean, di word of faith, wey we dey preach:
say if you confess with your mouth Lord Jesus, and believe for your heart say God raise am from di dead, you go dey saved.
Because with di heart, person dey believe and e dey result for righteousness; and with di mouth confession dey made and e dey result for salvation.
Because di Scripture talk, “Anybody wey believe am no go dey disappointed.”
Because no distinction dey between Jew and Greek; because di same Lord na Lord of all, and e rich to all wey call am.
Because, “Anybody wey call di name of di Lord go dey saved.”
So how dem go call di one wey dem no believe? How dem go believe di one wey dem no hear? How dem go hear without preacher?
And how dem go preach unless dem send dem? As e dey write, “How beautiful di feet of di people wey dey preach di Good News of peace, wey dey bring glad tidings of good things!”
But dem no all listen to di glad news. Because Isaiah talk, “Lord, who don believe wetin we report?”
So faith dey come by hearing, and hearing by di word of God.
But I talk, dem no hear? Yes, for sure, “dem sound go out enter all di earth, dem words reach di ends of di world.”
But I ask, Israel no know? First Moses talk, “I go provoke una to jealousy with wetin no be nation, with nation wey no get understanding I go make una angry.”
Isaiah bold well well, and talk, “Di people wey no seek me find me. I reveal myself to di people wey no ask for me.”
But as for Israel e talk, “All day long I stretch out my hands to disobedient and stubborn people.”
I ask den, God reject im people? E no go ever happen! Because I be Israelite too, descendant of Abraham, of di tribe of Benjamin.
God no reject im people, wey e know before. Or una no know wetin di Scripture talk about Elijah? How e plead with God against Israel:
“Lord, dem don kill your prophets. Dem don break down your altars. I remain alone, and dem dey seek my life.”
But how God answer am? “I don reserve for myself 7,000 men wey no bow knee to Baal.”
Na so den for this present time too remnant dey according to di election of grace.
But if na by grace, e no be of works again; if no be so grace no be grace again. But if na of works, e no be grace again; if no be so work no be work again.
Wetin den? Wetin Israel dey seek, e no obtain am, but di chosen ones obtain am, and di rest harden.
According as e dey write, “God give dem spirit of stupor, eyes wey no go see, and ears wey no go hear, reach this very day.”
David talk, “Make dem table become snare, trap, stumbling block, and retribution to dem.
Make dem eyes dark, so that dem no go see. Bow down dem back always.”
I ask den, dem stumble so that dem go fall? E no go ever happen! But by dem fall salvation don come to di Gentiles, to provoke dem to jealousy.
Now if dem fall na di riches of di world, and dem loss na di riches of di Gentiles; how much more dem fullness?
Because I dey talk to una wey be Gentiles. Since I be apostle to Gentiles, I give my ministry glory;
if by any means I fit provoke to jealousy di people wey be my own flesh, and fit save some of dem.
Because if dem rejection na di reconciling of di world, wetin dem acceptance go be, but life from di dead?
If di first fruit holy, di lump holy too. If di root holy, di branches holy too.
But if dem break off some of di branches, and you, as wild olive, dem graft you inside among dem and you become partaker with dem of di root and of di richness of di olive tree,
no boast over di branches. But if you boast, no be you dey support di root, but di root dey support you.
You go talk den, “Dem break off branches, so that dem go graft me inside.”
True; by unbelief dem break dem off, and you dey stand by faith. No dey proud, but fear;
because if God no spare di natural branches, e no go spare you too.
So see God goodness and severity: towards di people wey fall, severity; but towards you, goodness, if you continue for im goodness; if no be so dem go cut you off too.
Dem too, if dem no continue for dem unbelief, dem go graft dem inside, because God fit graft dem inside again.

Because if dem cut you from wetin be wild olive tree by nature, and graft you against nature enter good olive tree, how much more these ones, wey be natural branches, go dem graft enter dem own olive tree?
Because I no want make una no know this mystery, brothers, so that una no go dey wise for una own mind, say partial hardening don happen to Israel until di fullness of di Gentiles don come in,
and so all Israel go dey saved. Even as e dey write, “Di Deliverer go come out from Zion, and e go turn ungodliness away from Jacob.
This na my covenant to dem, when I go take away dem sins.”
About di Good News, dem be enemies for una sake. But about di election, dem be beloved for di papa dem sake.
Because God gifts and im calling no fit change.
Because as una for time past disobey God, but now don obtain mercy by dem disobedience,
na so these ones too don disobey now, so that by di mercy wey dem show una dem too go obtain mercy now.
Because God don lock all inside disobedience, so that e go get mercy on all.
Oh di depth of di riches both of di wisdom and di knowledge of God! How im judgments no fit dey searched out and im ways pass finding out!
“Because who don know di mind of di Lord? Or who don be im counselor?”
“Or who don first give am, and e go dey repaid am again?”
Because from am and through am and to am na all things. To am make glory dey forever! Amen.
So I urge una, brothers, by di mercies of God, to present una bodies as living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, wey be una spiritual service.
No conform to this world, but make una change by di renewing of una mind, so that una go prove wetin be di good, wey well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

Because I dey talk through di grace wey dem give me, to everybody wey dey among una, no think about yourself pass how you suppose think; but think soberly, as God don share to each person measure of faith.
Because just as we get many members for one body, and all di members no get di same function,
so we, wey plenty, na one body for Christ, and each one na member of di other.
As we get gifts wey different according to di grace wey dem give us, whether prophecy, make we prophesy according to di proportion of our faith;
or service, make we give ourselves to service; or di one wey dey teach, to im teaching;
or di one wey dey exhort, to im exhorting: di one wey dey give, make e do am with generosity; di one wey dey rule, with diligence; di one wey dey show mercy, with cheerfulness.
Make love no get hypocrisy. Hate wetin evil. Hold tight to wetin good.
For love of di brothers dey tenderly affectionate to each other; for honor dey put each other first;
no dey lazy for diligence; dey fervent for spirit; dey serve Lord;
dey rejoice for hope; dey endure for troubles; dey continue steadily for prayer;
dey contribute to di needs of di saints; dey give hospitality.
Bless di people wey dey persecute una; bless, and no curse.
Rejoice with di people wey dey rejoice. Cry with di people wey dey cry.
Get di same mind towards each other. No set una mind on high things, but mix with di humble. No dey wise for una own mind.
No pay anybody evil for evil. Respect wetin honorable for di sight of all men.
If e possible, as much as e dey una power, dey at peace with all men.
No seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God wrath. Because e dey write, “Vengeance belong to me; I go repay, di Lord talk.”
So “If your enemy hungry, feed am. If thirst dey am, give am drink; because as you do so, you go heap coals of fire on im head.”
No let evil overcome una, but overcome evil with good.
Make every soul dey subject to di higher authorities, because no authority dey except from God, and di ones wey dey, God don appoint dem.
So di one wey resist di authority, dey resist God ordinance; and di people wey resist go receive judgment for demself.
Because rulers no be terror to di good work, but to di evil. You want make you no fear di authority? Do wetin good, and you go get praise from am,
because e be servant of God to you for good. But if you do wetin evil, fear, because e no dey carry di sword for nothing; because e be servant of God, avenger for wrath to di one wey dey do evil.
So una need to dey subject, no only because of di wrath, but for conscience sake too.
For this reason una dey pay taxes too, because dem be servants of God service, dey attend continually to this very thing.
So give everybody wetin una owe: taxes to di one wey tax dey due; customs to di one wey customs; respect to di one wey respect; honor to di one wey honor.
No owe anybody anything, except to love each other; because di one wey love im neighbor don fulfill di law.

Because di commandments, “You no go commit adultery,” “You no go murder,” “You no go steal,” “You no go covet,” and whatever other commandments dey, dem all sum up for this saying, namely, “You go love your neighbor as yourself.”
Love no dey harm neighbor. So love na di fulfillment of di law.
Do this, as una know di time, say e don reach hour for una to wake from sleep, because salvation near us now pass when we first believe.
Di night don far, and di day near. So make we throw off di works of darkness, and make we put on di armor of light.
Make we waka properly, as for day; no for carousing and drunkenness, no for sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, no for strife and jealousy.
But put on Lord Jesus Christ, and no make provision for di flesh for im lusts.
Now accept di one wey weak for faith, but no for disputes over opinions.
One man get faith to chop all things, but di one wey weak dey chop vegetables only.
No let di one wey dey chop despise di one wey no dey chop. No let di one wey no dey chop judge di one wey dey chop, because God don accept am.
Who you be wey dey judge another person servant? To im own oga e dey stand or fall. Yes, dem go make am stand, because di Lord get power to make am stand.
One man consider one day more important. Another consider every day di same. Make each man dey fully sure for im own mind.
Di one wey observe di day, e observe am to di Lord. Di one wey dey chop, e dey chop to di Lord, because e dey thank God. Di one wey no dey chop, no dey chop to di Lord, and e dey thank God.
Because none of us dey live to imself, and none dey die to imself.
Because if we live, we dey live to di Lord. Or if we die, we dey die to di Lord. So if we live or die, we na di Lord own.
Because for this end Christ die, rise, and live again, so that e go be Lord of both di dead and di living.
But why you dey judge your brother? Or you again, why you dey despise your brother? Because we all go stand before di judgment seat of God.
Because e dey write, “‘As I dey live,’ di Lord talk, ‘every knee go bow to me, and every tongue go confess to God.’”
So each one of us go give account of imself to God.
So make we no judge each other again, but decide this rather, say make no man put stumbling block for im brother way, or occasion for falling.
I know, and I dey persuaded for Lord Jesus, say nothing dey unclean by itself; except say to di one wey consider anything unclean, to am e dey unclean.
Because if your food dey grieve your brother, you no dey waka for love again. No destroy with your food di one wey Christ die for.
Den no let people slander your good,
because God Kingdom no be eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy for Holy Spirit.
Because di one wey dey serve Christ for these things dey acceptable to God and men dey approve am.
So make we follow after things wey dey make for peace, and things wey we fit build each other up with.
No overthrow God work for meat sake. All things truly clean, but e evil for di man wey dey chop with offense.
E good to no chop meat, drink wine, or do anything wey go make your brother stumble, take offense, or weak.
You get faith? Keep am for yourself before God. Happy be di one wey no judge imself for wetin e approve.
But di one wey doubt dey condemned if e chop, because e no dey of faith; and whatever no dey of faith na sin.
Now we wey strong suppose bear di weaknesses of di weak, and no please ourselves.
Make each one of us please im neighbor for wetin good, to dey build am up.
Because even Christ no please imself. But, as e dey write, “Di reproaches of di people wey reproach you fall on me.”
Because whatever things dem write before, dem write dem for our learning, so that through perseverance and through encouragement of di Scriptures we go get hope.
Now make di God of perseverance and of encouragement grant una to get di same mind with each other according to Christ Jesus,
so that with one mind una go with one mouth give glory to di God and Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So accept each other, even as Christ accept una too, to di glory of God.
Now I talk say Christ don become servant of di circumcision for di truth of God, so that e go confirm di promises wey dem give di papa dem,
and so that di Gentiles go give God glory for im mercy. As e dey write, “So I go praise you among di Gentiles, and sing to your name.”
Again e talk, “Rejoice, una Gentiles, with im people.”
Again, “Praise di Lord, all una Gentiles! Make all di peoples praise am.”
Again, Isaiah talk, “Di root of Jesse go dey, di one wey go rise to rule over di Gentiles; for am di Gentiles go hope.”
Now make di God of hope fill una with all joy and peace as una believe, so that una go abound for hope, by di power of Holy Spirit.
I myself dey persuaded about una too, my brothers, say una yourselves full of goodness too, full of all knowledge, and fit warn each other too.
But I write more boldly to una for part, as person wey dey remind una, because of di grace wey God give me,
say I go be servant of Christ Jesus to di Gentiles, dey serve as priest di Good News of God, so that di offering of di Gentiles go dey acceptable, as Holy Spirit make am holy.
So I get my boasting for Christ Jesus about di things wey concern God.
Because I no go dare talk about anything except those things wey Christ work through me, for di obedience of di Gentiles, by word and deed,
by di power of signs and wonders, by di power of God Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round reach Illyricum, I don fully preach di Good News of Christ;
yes, as I dey make am my aim to preach di Good News, no for wia dem don name Christ before, so that I no go build on another person foundation.
But as e dey write, “Dem go see, di people wey no news of am reach. Di people wey no hear go understand.”
So dem stop me plenty times from coming to una too,
but now, as I no get any place again for these regions, and as I don get many years longing to come to una,
any time I travel go Spain, I go come to una. Because I hope to see una for my journey, and make una help me for my way there, if first I fit enjoy una company for small time.
But now, I talk, I dey go Jerusalem, dey serve di saints.
Because e please Macedonia and Achaia to make some contribution for di poor among di saints wey dey Jerusalem.
Yes, e please dem, and dem be dem debtors. Because if di Gentiles don become partakers of dem spiritual things, dem owe dem to serve dem for material things too.
So when I don finish this, and don seal this fruit to dem, I go pass through una go Spain.
I know say, when I come to una, I go come with di fullness of di blessing of di Good News of Christ.
Now I beg una, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by di love of di Spirit, say make una struggle together with me for una prayers to God for me,
so that I go dey delivered from di people wey disobey for Judea, and so that my service wey I get for Jerusalem go dey acceptable to di saints;
so that I go come to una with joy through God will, and together with una, find rest.
Now make di God of peace dey with una all. Amen.
I recommend Phoebe, our sister, to una, wey be servant of di assembly wey dey Cenchreae,
so that una receive am for di Lord, for way wey worthy of di saints, and so that una assist am for whatever matter e fit need from una, because e imself don be helper of many, and of me myself.
Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers for Christ Jesus,
wey, for my life, put dem own necks down; wey no be only me dey thank, but all di assemblies of di Gentiles too.
Greet di assembly wey dey dem house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, wey be di first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
Greet Mary, wey labor plenty for una.
Greet Andronicus and Junias, my relatives, and my fellow prisoners, wey notable among di apostles, wey dey Christ before me too.
Greet Ampliatus, my beloved for di Lord.
Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker for Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
Greet Apelles, di one wey dem approve for Christ. Greet di people wey dey Aristobulus household.
Greet Herodion, my relative. Greet di people for Narcissus household, wey dey di Lord.
Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, wey dey labor for di Lord. Greet Persis di beloved, wey labor plenty for di Lord.
Greet Rufus, di chosen for di Lord, and im mama and mine.
Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and di brothers wey dey with dem.
Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and im sister, and Olympas, and all di saints wey dey with dem.
Greet each other with holy kiss. Di assemblies of Christ dey greet una.
Now I beg una, brothers, look out for di people wey dey cause di divisions and occasions of stumbling, against di teaching wey una learn, and turn away from dem.
Because di people wey be like that no dey serve our Lord Christ, but dem own belly; and by dem smooth and flattering speech, dem dey deceive di hearts of di innocent.
Because una obedience don become known to all. So I rejoice over una. But I want make una wise for wetin good, but innocent for wetin evil.
Di God of peace go crush Satan under una feet soon. Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una.
Timothy my fellow worker dey greet una, as Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives dey greet una too.
I, Tertius, wey dey write di letter, dey greet una for di Lord.
Gaius, my host and di host of di whole assembly, dey greet una. Erastus, di treasurer of di city, dey greet una, as Quartus, di brother.
Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una all. Amen.
Now to di one wey fit establish una according to my Good News and di preaching of Jesus Christ, according to di revelation of di mystery wey dem don keep secret through long ages,
but now dem reveal am, and by di prophetic Scriptures, according to di commandment of di eternal God, dem make am known for obedience of faith to all di nations;
to God wey alone wise, make glory dey through Jesus Christ forever! Amen.
